## Checklist

<!-- Mark completed items with [x] -->

### General
- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) guidelines
- [ ] My changes follow the writing style and formatting of Protocol Zero
- [ ] I have checked for spelling and grammar errors
- [ ] I have tested all links (if applicable)

### Content Changes
- [ ] Information is accurate and up-to-date
- [ ] Sources are cited where appropriate
- [ ] Changes align with Protocol Zero's philosophy (practical, accessible, non-fearmongering)
- [ ] Technical terms are explained in plain language
- [ ] Priority markers ([CRITICAL], [RECOMMENDED], etc.) are used appropriately

### For Tool Recommendations
- [ ] Tool has been personally tested or thoroughly researched
- [ ] Pros and cons are fairly presented
- [ ] Alternatives are mentioned where appropriate
- [ ] Tool is still actively maintained
- [ ] Pricing/licensing information is current

### For Translations
- [ ] Translation maintains the meaning and tone of the original
- [ ] Technical terms are accurately translated
- [ ] Links are updated to localized versions where available
- [ ] File structure matches protocol/en/ structure
- [ ] Language code folder is correct
